ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A rectangular strip of paper of dimensions $4 \mathrm{~cm} \times 13 \mathrm{~cm}$ is folded as shown in the diagram. 2 rectangles are formed with areas $P$ and $Q$ where $P=2Q$. What is the value of $x$?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the paper strip is folded into a shape similar to an L. The left horizontal rectangle is labeled P, and the bottom edge is marked with length x; the vertical rectangle at the upper right is labeled Q. The right end of P and the left side of Q meet at the same vertical fold line. At the lower right corner there is a diagonal crease, labeled 45°, and a small right-angle region is completed with dashed lines, indicating that this crease crosses the 4 cm width of the paper strip. Reasoning: The original paper strip has width 4 cm, so the area of rectangle P is P = 4x. Let the vertical length of rectangle Q be y; according to the folding structure in the figure, the horizontal width of Q equals the paper strip width 4 cm, so Q = 4y. The problem gives P = 2Q, therefore 4x = 2(4y), giving x = 2y. The 45° crease crosses the 4 cm width of the paper strip, so its horizontal occupied length is also 4 cm. The total length 13 cm of the original paper strip is divided into x, this 4 cm folded-corner part, and y, therefore x + 4 + y = 13. Substituting x = 2y gives 2y + 4 + y = 13, 3y = 9, y = 3, so x = 6.

raw_record.question_text: A rectangular strip of paper of dimensions $4 \mathrm{~cm} \times 13 \mathrm{~cm}$ is folded as shown in the diagram. 2 rectangles are formed with areas $P$ and $Q$ where $P=2Q$. What is the value of $x$?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as an L-shaped folded strip: the left horizontal rectangle is P, with length x and height equal to the strip width 4 cm; the upper right rectangle is Q, with horizontal width also 4 cm and unknown vertical length y. The 45° fold shown in the corner crosses the full 4 cm width of the strip, so its horizontal run is also 4 cm; this means the corner/turning part uses 4 cm of the original 13 cm strip length. Use the original length partition x + 4 + y = 13. Since P=4x and Q=4y and the text gives P=2Q, get 4x=2(4y), so x=2y. Substitute into x+4+y=13 to obtain x=6 cm.

推理：原纸条宽为 4 cm，所以矩形 P 的面积为 P = 4x。设矩形 Q 的竖直长度为 y；按图中折叠结构，Q 的水平宽度等于纸条宽 4 cm，所以 Q = 4y。题给 P = 2Q，因此 4x = 2(4y)，得到 x = 2y。45° 折痕跨过纸条的 4 cm 宽度，所以它的水平占用长度也为 4 cm。原纸条总长 13 cm 被分成 x、这个 4 cm 折角部分、以及 y，因此 x + 4 + y = 13。代入 x = 2y，得 2y + 4 + y = 13，3y = 9，y = 3，所以 x = 6。

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that the two labeled rectangles P and Q are separated by a folded corner region. The dashed bottom and right edges together with the 45° diagonal show that this corner region is a square of side 4 cm, because the strip width is 4 cm and the diagonal makes a 45° angle. Therefore the corner region has area 16 cm². The whole strip area is 4×13=52 cm². Let the area of Q be A; then the text gives P=2A. Area conservation gives 2A + A + 16 = 52, so A=12 and P=24. Since P is the left rectangle of height 4 cm and length x, 4x=24, giving x=6 cm.
